text: Which of the following characterizes projective modules?
choices: P is a direct summand of a free module
P is a submodule of a free module
P is a quotient of a free module
explanation: The lifting property is equivalent to splitting off from a free module: choose a surjection F ↠ P from a free module and lift the identity of P. 'Quotient of free' is vacuous (every module is one), and over ℤ the submodule/torsion-free conditions are strictly weaker: ℚ is torsion-free but not projective.
